race.comment: HIGHWIRE GIRL (7) made nice progress last time out at the second run of the campaign, closing well to get up for second over 1320m at Lismore. Placed at both runs over today's trip and has a win and a placing from two third-up runs. Lovely profile. LATIN LIGHTS (2) raced handy and tried hard but found one better over 1536m at Lismore recently. Racing well deep into the prep and should show up again with the help of the inside alley. HOTZINO (5) has not raced for over seven weeks which is a negative but her efforts prior to the were commendable. Trifectas and first fours. TARA KODA (8) comes here off a five-week break. Ran a decent race last start at Grafton over this trip in better company, also when fresh from a little break. In the mix. ELITE DELIGHT (9) is not going well but can sneak into the top four.
